questions.stem: A 50-year-old man with no significant past medical history is admitted to the hospital following a hip fracture surgery. On the second day after surgery, his family reports that he has become increasingly fearful and disoriented. He appears to be fixated on the curtains in the room and insists that he sees "strange creatures" climbing on them. He also has fluctuating levels of consciousness and is agitated at times. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis for this patient?
